digest.component_or_area: GitHub Actions CI / Gerrit verification workflow
propositions: GitHub Actions pytest matrix jobs hang indefinitely at the 99% progress line on Gerrit patchsets that omit blob-fetch fix commit 96a0d5c3f, because unconditional --filter=blob:none followed by read-tree + checkout-index without up-front blob refill triggers one sequential fetch RPC per missing blob (~40 fetches for 2.1 hours total).

The _build-and-test.yml test job declares no timeout-minutes, so GitHub applies its 360-minute default instead of the documented 10–16 minute normal duration, requiring manual run cancellation to clear the CI queue.

Gerrit change 1129 PS3 introduced test_comment_map_matches_the_shared_contract which routes paging through _paged_search, but FakeJiraClient.search_issues ignored startAt/maxResults pagination parameters and returned the same non-empty issue list forever, causing the test to timeout instead of completing normally.
The worktree commit added jobs.test.timeout-minutes: 60 to the reusable pytest job in _build-and-test.yml, bounding job execution and preventing queue blockage when hangs occur.

The commit amended FakeJiraClient.search_issues to respect startAt and maxResults, slicing the issue list to produce an empty terminal page and allow _paged_search to terminate after a bounded number of iterations.
